questions.evidence:
NEIGHBORHOOD AUDIO WALK: Download the six recordings before leaving the community center. The route begins at the old fountain and ends at the reading garden. Each recording describes one stopping point. You may pause, repeat, or skip a recording and still follow the printed route map.

The complete route is about two kilometers and usually takes forty minutes without stops. The recordings add eighteen minutes altogether. Your total visit will be longer if you pause to draw, rest, or talk. The route is not a timed race, and no finish time is required.

Listen only while standing at a marked stopping point, not while crossing a street. Keep enough awareness of the surroundings to hear people nearby. If a path is closed, follow the posted detour and use the map; an old recording may still describe the usual route.

The free printed map is available at the front desk until four. Downloading the recordings is also free. The reading garden closes at five, so plan your departure time with any extra stops in mind.

A fee for pausing the audio.
